verdict.rationale: The pack documents only two models: full self-hosting, where you run the whole platform yourself, and Trigger.dev Cloud, where the vendor runs the managed compute. Neither is a hybrid where the vendor manages the control plane while workers run in your network. A community comment even notes that task code runs on Trigger's servers rather than where your app is hosted, so full self-hosting is only an adjacent alternative.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I run workers in my own infrastructure while the vendor manages the orchestration control plane — code and data stay inside my network
